user_journeys.description: General website navigation and content discovery

proposed_scenarios.scenario_name: Discovered Workflow: navigation_flow - Verify Homepage Accessibility
proposed_scenarios.description: This is a foundational smoke test to confirm the website's homepage loads successfully. As no user interactions were captured during the exploration phase, this is the only scenario that can be generated based on the provided data. It validates the primary entry point of the user journey.
proposed_scenarios.business_goal: Verify the website is online, accessible, and the homepage loads correctly for all users.
proposed_scenarios.user_story: As a first-time visitor, I want to successfully load the homepage so that I can begin discovering the store's products.

detailed_steps.description: Load the main website homepage and verify the URL and page title are correct.
detailed_steps.verification_point: Page title is 'ATID Demo Store – ATID College'
detailed_steps.business_impact: Site accessibility is the first and most critical step for any user engagement or potential sale.

expected_results: The page loads without any critical errors.
The page title matches 'ATID Demo Store – ATID College', confirming the correct site has been reached.
edge_cases_to_test: How the page loads on different network conditions (e.g., slow 3G).
Page load behavior with browser cache disabled.
Accessibility on various screen resolutions and devices.
data_requirements: No specific user data is required for this scenario.
prerequisites: The website 'https://atid.store/' is deployed and expected to be online.
The test environment has a stable internet connection.
